items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play vs Jets Sunday after practicing this week (high-ankle sprain).
items.why: Returned to practice all week limited; anticipated return
items.implication: Instant WR2 upside; Berry plans to start as WR2

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely due to superficial blood clot. First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; info gathering continues
items.implication: McKee at QB with healthy top-4 pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks) but 4th-string RB
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume stable or up; RB committee limited

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury.
items.implication: PHI backfield to Dameon Pierce/Carson Steele; thin RB room with Shipley on IR
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries to backups in good matchup vs CAR run D

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday groin Q add. Probable-leaning: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin WRs (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers but 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce.
items.why: Practice reports and tags; Friday adds
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; Metcalf target monster in 2-WR; PHI pass game intact
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes/targets up; PHI WR/TE stable volume despite RB thinness

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Sunday; Ravens play another game without him.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Flowers remains viable WR2

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell.

items.opportunity: Elevated route/target share for remaining WRs

items.text: Ladd McConkey IN (along with Quentin Johnston).
DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty IN/cleared.
items.why: Removed from injury concerns / practiced fully
items.implication: Smith returns to healthy PHI pass-catchers; Lamb/Jeanty full go

items.text: LOVE Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume vs leaky run Ds; also Purdy (QB2 vs WSH), Stafford, Jordan Love. Notes Hurts OUT/McKee and Saquon status.
items.why: Elite recent usage (Kyren), goal-line (Javonte), volume + matchups; high-scoring environments

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI), JK Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@KC) due to tough matchups, shaky QB, or low totals.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA pass/run D), limited recent targets, lowest team totals

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks him WR4 for Week 6. All-in on the matchup.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass catchers; strong usage
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share vs soft secondary
